provenance.note: Upper-bound sketch, not measured. Body linears are 12.23 of 16.68 GB per EXL3 MTP3 round; EXL3 reaches 381 GB/s and 636 logical-byte GB/s when trellis decode is skipped (B_FAKE). wall_fraction 0.75 = assumed share of round time spent in body linears. local_speedup 1.40 = an assumed 550 GB/s for a 4.125 bpw affine INT4-G128 kernel with block-128 Hadamard wraps versus 381 GB/s at 4.0 bpw (550/381 x 4/4.125). Assumes equal MTP3 acceptance, which requires equal target quality.
